title: Command Line Input Elements Refactor
description: Establish one enforced contract for the window command line engagement controls (no command active -> nothing shown below the input), add toggleGroup and select control kinds, and fix every playground that leaks persistent sliders/pickers outside that contract.
summary:
Established command-line engagement control contract: controls only when sessionActive is true (enforced in enforcePlaygroundWindowEngagementInput).

Added toggleGroup and select engagement control kinds end-to-end (WindowEngagement types, EngagementSpec UI, windowEngagementControlToGolden bridging, EngagementControlView rendering).

Moved persistent layout sliders from engagement.controls to windowMeasures() in flow, sequence, dag, procedural-2d, procedural-3d.

Removed writer duplicate engagement controls; added tab size to measures rail.

Refactored puzzle-2d/3d/5d: tool picker moved to options; brush placement uses session-gated toggleGroup (<=6) or select (>6).

Tests: ui/react engagement control test; playground core enforce test; puzzle-3d buildPuzzle3dPlayEngagement tests updated and passing.
